pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/executions/[id]/stream/route.ts:13 This context reads the history and the output stream of runs that an external orchestrator executes. It never builds a hook chain, never loads contributed code and never stores or resumes conversation checkpoints. A case-insensitive grep of src/app/api/executions and src/components/dashboard for checkpoint, plugin, subagent, middleware and hookChain found no hits, so the subject's precondition (this code assembling an agent runtime) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/executions/useExecutionsList.ts:48 The polling here is a browser list refreshing while a run is active, not a model loop polling a remote tool job, so the technique's precondition is absent.

src/components/dashboard/views/executions/executions-page/ExecutionOutput.tsx:28 Status is read from the orchestrator and only rendered. This code never runs recovery and never closes interrupted work, so it has no closure status of its own to choose.

src/app/api/executions/[id]/stream/route.ts:49 This environment variable chooses where the proxy sends requests (it returns 501 when the target is desktop). It is not a capability in an agent's tool roster, so the roster rule does not apply.
